messages:
June L.: posting a quick design review: prototyping a compact timeline variant that includes a mini-map overview and per-row percent pills for canaries. Main asks: a11y announce rules, tooltip copy for non-technical users, and rollback CTA defaults.

Arjun S.: initial thought: percent pill (e.g., '10%') should be visible in collapsed rows. Make it a focusable element with aria-label 'Canary 10 percent' so keyboard/SR users can get the number without expanding.

Priya L.: agree. For SR announcements keep collapsed rows short: 'Version release-2026-06-03, canary 10%'. Hide sha/author by default and surface via a 'More info' button with aria-expanded. That prevents long reads.

Tom B.: mini-map: use color + pattern to indicate status and active vs completed rollouts. Ensure the mini-map has an accessible summary like 'Timeline overview: 8 releases, 1 active canary' and each marker is focusable with readable text.

June L.: microcopy: replace raw term 'canary' tooltip with 'Canary — small-scale test rollout'. Keep it short and localizable. For the rollback primary CTA, PMs prefer a safe default. Options: 'Start rollback' -> opens modal with gradual preselected. Secondary destructive: 'Force rollback (all traffic)'.

Arjun S.: in the rollback modal, make primary CTA 'Start gradual rollback' and secondary red 'Force rollback (all traffic)'. Force should require typing the version string to confirm. Keyboard users should be able to trigger both flows without mouse.

Priya L.: live-region behavior: announce traffic milestone updates with aria-live='polite' but debounce to 1.5s and de-duplicate by event id. Example announcement: 'Canary reached 10% traffic for release-2026-06-03'. Localize the format.

Tom B.: sparklines per row OK but must have alt text like 'Latency sparkline: median 110ms, p95 290ms'. On hover show expanded chart. Also, when timeline is compact, action buttons collapse into overflow; ensure the overflow menu is labelled 'Version actions' and rollback remains first item when present.

deploy-bot: event: rollout 3112 -> canary 10% at 2224567990 UTC

June L.: accessibility checklist for handoff: 1) collapsed SR announcement short, 2) percent pill focusable + aria-label, 3) 'More info' button with aria-expanded to reveal sha/author, 4) live-region debounced + localized messages, 5) rollback modal with confirm-input for force.

Arjun S.: I'll prototype the compact timeline + mini-map and wire the live-region hook. Tom, can you mock the rollback modal contents?

Tom B.: on it. I'll include keyboard-only flows and the confirm-input pattern.

Priya L.: I'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass once the prototype link is up and report any SR phrasing issues.

June L.: great. I'll file the ticket with mock links, copy strings, and the acceptance criteria. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
